Title: A Day to Remember

Cast

1. Aarav - 11 years, son
Look: red T-shirt, jeans
2. Shalini - 39 years, mother
Look: yellow kurta, jeans
3. Kavya - 12 years, friend
Look: yellow frock, two plaits
4. Vihaan - 12 years, friend
Look: red T-shirt, jeans
5. Savitri - 74 years, grandmother
Look: white saree, glasses

Places

1. The park - green grass, swings, benches

Scene 1: The park - Day

[Aarav stands in the park. Shalini and Vihaan stand near him.]

Vihaan: "Today feels like a good day."

[Aarav plays cricket in the park.]

Shalini: "Good job, Aarav!"

[Aarav goes down the slide.]

Aarav: "Let's do this again tomorrow!"
